takeaways.text: Lines up **Slot** on **50%** of 155 plays (n=77); also Inline (tight) 41% (n=64).
Route on **93%** / blocks on **7%** of dropbacks (95% CI 88–96%, n=155) — 6 pts above the TE average of 86%.
On routes, averages **11.1 yd** downfield by the throw vs 8.2 for TEs (deeper) (n=143, snap→release window only).

Because he releases into a route on ~93% of dropbacks and most often from Slot, a coach might account for him as a receiver there rather than expecting help in protection — to be validated against film and matchup.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (10.9 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
